title: Effect-binding, server side: do public remote MCP servers bind an executed effect to the authorisation that permitted it
honesty: Measurement, not certification. A verdict is one deterministic probe of one public endpoint on one day under the safety rules below; it is not a grade, a rank, a security claim or evidence about any vendor beyond the bytes logged. UNCHECKABLE and UNREACHABLE are counted and never scored. Third-party and SELF rows are separate tables and are never added.
construct: Does the SERVER bind an executed effect to the authorisation that permitted it: can an effect pass under an authorisation for a different one (P2, argument binding), can a consumed authorisation be replayed (P3), and does the server return evidence binding what ran to what was authorised (P4)? P1 records what the server declares.
n_note: n counts THIRD-PARTY servers that answered and received a verdict (BINDS, PARTIAL or DOES_NOT_BIND). Servers tried, dropped and SELF are reported beside it, never inside it.

population.self_rule: io.github.CSOAI-ORG/* and any remote on councilof.ai or csoai.org, plus the two known doors councilof.ai/mcp and councilof.ai/api/a2a

frozen_slice.rule: the parent's whole frozen slice: the same 600 third-party servers (seed 20260922), tried again whatever their parent outcome; the run's own seeded shuffle only orders the work queue

population.bank_kind: subset of the frozen 2026-09-22 bank: the parent run's 600-server frozen slice (seed 20260922, first 600 of the seeded shuffle of 20,992 third-party rows), in the parent's slice order, plus the 41 SELF rows
population.selection_rule: population.frozen_slice.chosen_names of the signed 2026-09-22 artifact (all 600 tried servers, whatever their 2026-09-22 outcome) + every SELF row; URLs as harvested on 2026-09-22
population.registry_note: No registry was re-read. The same remote URL probed on the parent date is probed again (URL equal for every third-party row); a server that moved its endpoint since is probed at the old one.

safety_rules: only tools whose name carries a read verb and whose description announces no mutation; annotations readOnlyHint:false or destructiveHint:true exclude
one initialize + one tools/list + at most three tools/call per server
>= 2 s between requests to one host; any 429 stops that host
no credentials supplied; 401/403/402 => UNCHECKABLE, no attempt to obtain any
undocumented argument is the literal key csoai_probe_unauthorised: true

instrument.P1_declared_binding: verbatim field NAMES matching nonce|idempoten|authori[sz]ation_(ref|id|token)|auth_ref|receipt|attestation|signature|sig|jws|cose|request_(hash|digest)|content_digest|proof_of in tools/list input/output schema properties, initialize capabilities, or /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
instrument.P2_argument_binding: read-only tool with synthesised documented arguments (baseline), then identical call plus csoai_probe_unauthorised:true. REJECTS = baseline ok and extra-arg answered by HTTP 4xx, JSON-RPC error, or isError:true; ACCEPTS_SILENTLY = both ok; both failed => REJECTS only if the extra-arg error names the unknown argument, else INDETERMINATE; a failed baseline on the first tool moves to the next read-only tool
instrument.P3_replay: only if the read-only tool exposes a nonce/idempotency/request_id/authorisation-ref/challenge field: identical request twice with the same value
instrument.P4_evidence_returned: a key in a tools/call RESULT body whose name-token is signature|sig|jws|cose|receipt|attestation|proof or matches request_(hash|digest|sha256)|content_digest|repr_digest AND whose value is an object or a hash/base64/JWS-like string (>=32 chars; >=40 for signature-class); identifier keys (*_id, *Id) never count; or a Signature/Signature-Input/Content-Digest/Repr-Digest/X-Receipt/X-Attestation response header. tools/list schemas and initialize are NOT evidence. P4 was regraded from the recorded bytes after this value-shape rule replaced a name-only rule (see regrade)
instrument.verdict: BINDS = P1 declared AND P2 REJECTS AND P4 present; DOES_NOT_BIND = P2 ACCEPTS_SILENTLY AND P4 absent; UNCHECKABLE = P2 INDETERMINATE or auth wall; PARTIAL = anything else
instrument.code: eb_harvest.py / eb_mcp.py / eb_probe.py / eb_controls.py / eb_run.py / eb_publish.py, published beside this file

grader_can_fail.injected_defect: EB_FLIP=p2_errors_are_acceptance: P2 no longer counts a JSON-RPC/HTTP/tool error as rejection

controls.abort_rule: if either control misgraded or the injected defect left the verdict unchanged, ABORT.json is written and no public server is probed

P2_argument_binding.denominator_is: servers on which a read-only tool was called

P3_replay.denominator_is: same as P2; NOT_APPLICABLE = no nonce/idempotency/authorisation-ref field on the read-only tool

P4_evidence_returned.denominator_is: servers with at least one tools/call response

method_limitations: P2 observes the server's boundary, not its backend: a server that strips unknown arguments (the zod/pydantic default) and one that passes them through both answer ok and both grade ACCEPTS_SILENTLY. The probe cannot tell strip from pass-through from outside; DOES_NOT_BIND on P2 means the unauthorised argument was not refused, not that it was used.

Baseline arguments are synthesised from the schema (first enum, 'csoai', 1, false, empty). A tool that errors on a synthesised value gives INDETERMINATE unless the extra-arg error names the argument; such servers are UNCHECKABLE, not scored.

Authenticated servers (401/403/402 at initialize) are UNCHECKABLE by rule; no credential was sought. The verdict population is therefore biased toward servers that serve anonymous callers, which may bind differently from authenticated ones.
One read-only tool per server (two if the first baseline failed). A server may bind other tools differently.
